markets.rules_primary: If Seth Curry signs a contract with any team in the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA) after issuance and before Oct 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Seth Curry must have a qualifying signing after this market is issued and before 12:00 AM ET at the start of Oct 1, 2027.
A CBA team means a professional team officially recognized by the Chinese Basketball Association, the top-level men's league in China. Other Chinese or Taiwanese leagues, national teams, and separate affiliate clubs do not count.
A signing qualifies when the CBA team officially announces the signing or the CBA officially registers the contract. The first qualifying official announcement or registration controls; the player does not need to appear in a game. Media reports of an agreement alone are insufficient.
An earlier signing outside the CBA does not by itself prevent a qualifying CBA signing before the deadline. This market is not limited to the player's first new team.
If the player formally retires from professional basketball before signing with a CBA team, the market resolves to No.
